name: Variation Swatches and Gallery for WooCommerce
author: TaskPlugins

sections.description:
Variation Swatches and Gallery for WooCommerce enhances the standard WooCommerce variable product display by replacing default dropdown menus with customizable swatches, radio buttons, and color circles, while also allowing slider thumbnail positions for each product gallery with introducing flexible gallery layouts. The plugin enhances the WooCommerce shopping experience.

👉 Plugin Demo | Documentation | Get Pro 👈

Core Features & Highlights

✨ Attribute Swatches: Replaces default drop-down selectors with interactive color circles, custom shapes/styles, or select and radio buttons.

✨ Image slider: Uses Slick Slider for smooth, responsive navigation of the main product gallery image.

✨ Thumbnail position (Top/ Bottom) : Offers flexible positioning for product gallery thumbnails with options to align them on the top and bottom.

✨ Thumbnail slider: Uses Slick Slider for smooth, responsive navigation of the main product thumbnail image.

✨ Zoom option: Enables a zoom feature on main product images, allowing detailed viewing across all color and style variations.

✨ Light box: Enables a lightbox popup for viewing product variation and main gallery images in a full-screen, high-resolution display.

✨ Global & Product-Level Controls: Configure settings globally via WordPress Admin → Tools → Swatches & Gallery or customize them per product under the product editor tab.

How to Work Settings with Swatches and Gallery.

✨ Thumbnail Position: Top and Attibute Shape: Radio — Features top-aligned product thumbnails alongside radio-style shapes for attribute selection.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position: Bottom and Attibute Shape: Select — Features bottom-aligned product gallery thumbnails alongside dropdown select controls for attribute swatch selection.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position: Left and Attibute Shape: Checkbox (Pro) — Left-aligned thumbnail positioning seamlessly pairs with customizable checkbox attributes to deliver an elegant, interactive gallery and swatch experience.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position: Right and Attibute Shape: Checkbox (Pro) — Positions thumbnails on the right and uses checkbox-style shapes for swatch and product gallery attribute selection.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position: Left and Attibute Shape: Radio (Pro) — Features left-aligned thumbnails for the product gallery alongside radio-style shapes for attribute swatch selection.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position: Right and Attibute Shape: Radio ( Pro ) — Features right-aligned product gallery thumbnails alongside radio-style shapes for attribute swatch selection.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

Compatibility

The Variation Swatches and Gallery for the WooCommerce plugin is integrated into WooCommerce and WordPress, but only where necessary. It’s unlikely to conflict with other plugins.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Variation Swatches and Gallery for WooCommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Swatches & Gallery to set the settings.
  4. Go to WooCommerce product to Add New or Edit products.
sections.faq:
How to Use WooCommerce Variation Swacthes and Gallery

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Swatches & Gallery

Is it compatible with any kinds of WooCommerce Theme?

Yes, it is compatible with Most popular WooCommerce themes , but need some css update.

How do I configure product attributes as swatches?

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Products → Attributes.
    • Fill out the attribute form and select your desired attribute type (such as Color).
    • Click Add Attribute. You can then configure individual terms and set visual values.

How do I use the Variation Gallery?

  • Go to Products and open or create a Variable Product.
  • Scroll down to the Product Data box and select the Variations tab.
  • Open a variation accordion box to manage specific product information and upload/manage individual variation gallery images. By default, the first image for each variation box will dynamically show up as a gallery image on the front end when selected.

Can I customize swatch and gallery settings for an individual product?

Yes. If global overrides are not enforced, you can configure settings per product while editing a variable product by looking for the Swatches & Gallery tab inside the Product Data panel.

How do global override settings work?

If you want uniform styling across your entire store, you can enable global overrides.

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Swatches & Gallery → Settings.
  • Configure your options for attribute shapes and thumbnail position.
  • Save settings. When override is enabled, it applies globally and overrides individual product-level configuration.

Where can I get support if I encounter bugs or issues?

If you face any issues, need technical help, or want to submit suggestions, you can open a support ticket via the official TaskPlugins Support Ticket Portal.
